summary: Added 10 guard-clause tests to DapperMovieCatalogRepositoryTests.cs: null/whitespace variants for MovieExistsAsync (hash), InsertMovieAsync (hash), FilenameExistsAsync (filename), and AddFilenameAsync (filename and hash). comments.note: The integration test class DapperMovieCatalogRepositoryTests is decorated with [Collection("LiveDB")] which prevents xUnit from running it in parallel with other live-DB tests. The 10 new guard-clause tests do not need a live DB but sit inside this class — they still acquire the class fixture and are subject to the collection constraint. A minor improvement would be to house pure unit/guard tests in a separate test class to avoid fixture overhead, but this is out of scope for the current WP.

summary: Code review PASS. 10 guard-clause tests covering null/whitespace inputs for MovieExistsAsync, InsertMovieAsync, FilenameExistsAsync, and AddFilenameAsync (2 params × 2 variants) are clean and correct. NeverCalledConnectionFactory stub is a well-designed self-verifying seam. Tests correctly use [Fact] (not [SkippableFact]). comments.note: Guard tests are [Fact] (not [SkippableFact]) which is correct. However, because DapperMovieCatalogRepositoryTests is [Collection("LiveDB")] and IClassFixture<LiveDbFixture>, the constructor opens a live DB connection and begins a transaction even for the 10 pure-unit guard tests. The guard tests are functionally correct in both DB-available and DB-absent environments, but incur unnecessary fixture overhead when a live DB is configured. A future refactoring could house guard tests in a separate class with only NeverCalledConnectionFactory — out of scope for this WP.

NeverCalledConnectionFactory is a clean self-verifying stub — throwing InvalidOperationException confirms no DB access occurs during guard tests. Well-named and well-documented. The AddFilenameAsync tests correctly cover all 4 combinations (null filename, whitespace filename, null hash, whitespace hash), with guard ordering matching production code (filename first, then hash).

No blocking or structural observations — all 10 new tests are clean, minimal, and follow established patterns. The CreateGuardSut() static factory cleanly separates guard-test setup from live-DB setup.
